name: Apollo 10 LM
about: Apollo 10 LM (1969-043D), a crewed vehicle (LM AS), launched 1969 May 18. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DSO).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1969 May 18), held fixed
